messages:
anya: Heads-up — saw a regression after the kernel-picker change. Medium seq lengths (512–1024) are ~12–18% slower on our A100 pools.
matt: Ugh. Any profiler output or a minimal repro? link?
anya: Pushed a short microbench to ci/artifacts. nvprof summary pasted below. Not super pretty but shows the spike when picker prefers the higher-occupancy tile.
anya: ```
kernel: matmul_tile_64x32_prefetch
achieved_occupancy: 0.82
registers_per_thread: 78
reg_spill_stores: 124000
l2_miss_rate: 0.13
latency_p50: 18.2ms (was 15.9ms)
``` 
matt: That reg count is the smoking gun — spills are killing L2/DRAM. Which picker rule picked that kernel? show config.
sam: The new autotuner has "occupancy_first" as a heuristic for medium seqs. It prefers larger tiles to boost occupancy which accidentally raises per-thread register usage on Ampere. Also KV cache makes effective seqlen distribution skewed toward longer prefixes so the picker sees more long-ish traces.
lina: Could we try a warp-specialized path? split tile across warps so per-thread regs drop. Or enforce a max_reg budget in the picker.
anya: Current picker snippet: `kernel_picker: { strategy: "occupancy_first", tile_hint: "auto", max_regs: 128 }` — note max_regs is high (we thought avoiding reg-throttling). Changing it down to 64 might avoid spills.
sam: Another quick experiment: add a preference for "low_reg_path" when predicted seq median < 1100 and batch < 12. That keeps latency tight for medium workloads.
perf-bot: flamegraph: https://ci.redwood/arti/1759992222/flame.svg — top hot paths show spill-store hotness in matmul_tile_64x32_prefetch
matt: Can someone run this locally: `./bench --seq=512 --batch=8 --picker=low_reg_hint` — compare p50 and reg spill counters.
anya: Running now on an a100-40gb instance, will paste numbers in ~10m :eyes:
lina: Also try `tile_size=32x32, warp_affinity=per_tile` and measure achieved_occupancy/reg_spill_stores. Small tiles reduce live regs per thread.
sam: FYI, KV cache change we rolled last week adds a prefix copy in kernel prologue which temporarily inflates live register usage. If we combine that with larger tiles we get a spill cliff.
matt: Action items: (1) Anya run the low_reg bench and the 32x32 tile bench. (2) Sam add a quick picker rule to prefer low_reg for medium seqs. (3) Lina prototype warp-specialization config. I'll triage rollout gating depending on results. :thumbsup:
anya: Got bench results: low_reg_hint p50=16.1ms reg_spill_stores=12k; current picker p50=18.2ms reg_spill_stores=124k. 32x32 tile p50=15.8ms reg_spill_stores=8k.
matt: Nice. Those numbers argue we should change picker defaults and add a safety cap on regs.
sam: I'll open a tiny PR with a new rule and a regression test that runs on a100 microbench. link to PR in a bit.
lina: I'll prototype the warp-specialization as an opt-in feature so we can A/B it without touching defaults.
anya: tagging results into the perf doc and will update the rollout checklist. thanks all. :rocket:
